title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - PowerLine
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/PowerLine. Interconnected network for electricity delivery from producers to consumers. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (core SAREF).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerLine'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasProperty.description: Relationship (saref:hasProperty, core SAREF). Links this power line to one of its EnergyAndPowerProperty or QualityProperty instances (e.g. its ActiveEnergy, Voltage, or DurationVoltageSag).
